items.title: What a Republican 'wipeout' in the midterm elections means for investors
items.summary: Veda Partners managing partner and director of economic policy Henrietta Treyz outlines the type of policy shifts that could affect investors most if the Republicans end up "wiping out" in the midterm elections.

items.title: People Inc. CEO on rebranding, AI challenges
items.summary: People Inc. (PPLI) CEO Neil Vogel joins Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to discuss the publisher's rebranding strategy, evolving media business, and the challenges AI poses to its content and audience.

items.title: AppLovin vs. Meta Platforms: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
items.summary: AppLovin's profit margins are among the highest in digital advertising, while Meta's user base is unmatched anywhere on earth.

items.title: Nscale adds former OpenAI exec Fidji Simo to its board ahead of potential IPO
items.summary: The No. 2 exec at OpenAI also led Instacart through its IPO in 2023.

items.title: Stock Market Falls On Soaring Oil Prices, Yields, But Finishes Strong; CPI Inflation, Apple, Oracle, Meta In Focus: Weekly Review
items.summary: The stock market fell as oil prices and Treasury yields soared, but rebounded Friday on the CPI inflation report. Apple, Oracle, Meta were key movers.

items.title: Netflix Said It Was Different From Facebook. A New Lawsuit Says It Tracked Kids for Ads Anyway.
items.summary: Florida is suing Netflix for billions, accusing the streaming giant of secretly tracking children for advertisers while publicly promising families a safe alternative to social media surveillance. The outcome could unravel the economics powering Netflix's fastest-growing business.

items.title: Mark Zuckerberg May Have Found Meta’s Next Hit. Would You Hand It Your Email and Passwords?
items.summary: Meta's new AI agent Muse shot to third on the US App Store in two days, but the feature that makes it genuinely useful is the same one giving analysts pause: it needs your inbox, your accounts, and possibly your passwords to work.
